theorems.name: Submission.ptd_piece_image_measurable_ae_pullback
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L F → MeasurableSet B → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖F a - F a'‖) → MeasurableSet (F '' B) ∧ ∀ p : Euclid P → Prop, (∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict (F '' B)), p y) → ∀ᵐ b ∂(volume.restrict B), p (F b)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
